summary.text: Dave Marsden is a Democratic member of the Senate of Virginia representing District 35.
The Senate biography lists Dave Marsden's service in the House of Delegates from 2006 to 2010 and in the Senate since 2010.

paragraphs.text: According to the Senate biography, Dave Marsden was born in Alexandria, Virginia, on April 5, 1948.
Dave Marsden studied at Randolph-Macon College.
Dave Marsden's listed occupation is former Chief Deputy and Acting Director of the Virginia Department of Juvenile Justice (2000-2002).

Dave Marsden's listed memberships and affiliations include the board of directors of Fairfax Court Appointed Special Advocates (2007 to the present), former president of the Virginia Juvenile Justice Association, and former president of the Virginia Council on Juvenile Detention.
The biography lists Julia Marsden as Dave Marsden's spouse.
The Senate page lists Dave Marsden's committee assignments as Agriculture, Conservation and Natural Resources (Chair), Commerce and Labor, General Laws and Technology, Transportation, and Rules.
